A CFD (computational fluid dynamics) engineer in India typically starts on ₹


3-4.5 lakh a year. In 240 Skill-Lync CFD placements the median starting offer was ₹


3.5 lakh. With 1-3 years' experience, AmbitionBox puts the average at ₹


5.8-6.4 lakh. It rises to ₹


7.6-8.4 lakh at 3-6 years, and senior CFD engineers average ₹


11-12 lakh. The employer and the industry move pay more than the city.


This guide starts with our own placement data, which no salary site has. It splits that data by fresher or experienced, by job title and by placement year. Then come the AmbitionBox and Glassdoor figures for working engineers, the companies that hire, what moves pay and how CFD compares with FEA. Every number names its source, its date and how many people it rests on.


*About our numbers:* Based on 3,711 Skill-Lync placement records up to 2026-11-07 (data snapshot of 2026-11-15). Of these, 240 are CFD placements. These are learners who chose to report a placement, so this is not a survey of the whole job market. Most are starting or early-career offers from 2021-2023, and recent years are thin: our CFD records have 17 placements from 2024, 2 from 2025 and none from 2026. Groups with fewer than 10 people are left out, and salaries outside 0.5-60 lakh were dropped as entry errors. Treat this as a starting point. We will update it as new placements come in. The individual records are public on our[recent placements page](https://skill-lync.com/recent-placements) .


## How much does a CFD engineer earn in India?


A CFD engineer in India earns about ₹


3.5 lakh a year at the start (Skill-Lync placement median, n = 240) and about ₹


5.8-6.4 lakh after one to three years (AmbitionBox average range, 683 salaries). Glassdoor's average across all experience levels is ₹


6.85 lakh (155 salaries). Senior engineers with six or more years average ₹


9-12 lakh.


The sources measure different things, so read them side by side rather than as one number:

Skill-Lync figures: snapshot 15 Nov 2026, records up to 7 Nov 2026. AmbitionBox pages were updated 12-14 Nov 2026 and Glassdoor's is "as of Nov 2026". We read both on 16 Nov 2026 while logged out.


Why is our median lower than AmbitionBox's lowest band? Our records are mostly first offers made in 2021-23, many to freshers. AmbitionBox's 1-3 year band is people already in the job, reporting their pay in 2026. The two numbers bracket the first few years of a CFD career rather than contradict each other.


## What salary does a fresher CFD engineer get in India?


A fresher CFD engineer in India usually gets ₹


2.8-4.5 lakh a year. Among 150 freshers placed in CFD roles through Skill-Lync, the median offer was ₹


3.5 lakh, the middle half fell between ₹


2.8 and ₹


4.5 lakh, and the top 10% got more than ₹


5.39 lakh (snapshot 15 Nov 2026). At the median that is about ₹


29,167 a month before tax and PF deductions.


The job title on the offer letter matters. Offers titled "CFD Engineer" had a median of ₹


3.55 lakh (n = 122). Offers titled Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) or trainee had a median of ₹


3.25 lakh (n = 46). Trainee roles often come with a training period, after which the title and pay change, so ask what the salary will be after training before you compare offers.


Median, middle half and 90th percentile of starting offers, by group, with n beside each. Snapshot: 15 Nov 2026, records up to 7 Nov 2026. Source: Skill-Lync placement records.


How to read the chart: the dot is the median, the offer in the middle when all offers are sorted. The bar is the middle half of offers, and the amber tick marks the point that only one in ten offers beat. Look at the bar, not only the dot. The middle half of fresher offers spans ₹


1.7 lakh, from ₹


2.8 to ₹


4.5 lakh.


If you are preparing for your first CFD interview, our[50 CFD engineer interview questions with worked examples](https://skill-lync.com/blogs/top-cfd-engineer-interview-questions-you-must-know) covers the turbulence, meshing and boundary-condition questions that come up most.


## How much do experienced CFD engineers earn?


Experienced CFD engineers in India average ₹


7.6-8.4 lakh with three to six years, ₹


9.3-11.9 lakh with six to nine years, and ₹


11.1-12.3 lakh under the "Senior CFD Engineer" title (AmbitionBox, read 16 Nov 2026). Engineers who joined CFD roles with prior experience got a median starting offer of ₹


4.5 lakh in Skill-Lync's records (n = 36).


The "experienced" group in our data means people who already had work experience when they took the CFD offer. Their median was ₹


1 lakh above the fresher median, and their top 10% got more than ₹


7.58 lakh. That is the clearest sign in our data that earlier work experience still counts when you move into simulation.


What working CFD engineers report, by title and experience, with the number of salaries behind each bar. Source: AmbitionBox, read 16 Nov 2026. Dashed line: Skill-Lync CFD starting median, snapshot 15 Nov 2026, n = 240.


Three things stand out in the AmbitionBox data:


- **The first jump is the big one.** The midpoint of the "CFD Engineer" average range rises from ₹


6.1 lakh at 1-3 years to ₹


8.0 lakh at 3-6 years, about 31%.
- **The title "CFD Analyst" pays about the same as "CFD Engineer"** at each experience level. In the automobile industry, though, CFD analysts average ₹


9.5-12.9 lakh (65 salaries), against ₹


6.8-8.4 lakh in IT services (67).
- **Specialist roles pay most, but the sample is tiny.** "CFD Specialist" has a typical range of ₹


12.6-14 lakh, and ₹


15.5-17.1 lakh at 9-12 years, but rests on only 39 salaries. Treat it as a direction, not a benchmark.


Pay growth at the senior end has been flat lately. AmbitionBox shows a 5% rise in the average "CFD Engineer" salary over the last two years and a 5% drop for "Senior CFD Engineer". A drop like that can come from a change in who reports, not from pay cuts.


## Are CFD salaries going up? Pay by placement year


In Skill-Lync's records, the median CFD starting offer rose from ₹


2.6 lakh in 2020 (n = 14) to ₹


3.5 lakh in 2022 (n = 102) and ₹


3.6 lakh in 2023 (n = 55). The 2024 median was ₹


4.5 lakh, but it rests on only 17 placements, and we have too few records from 2025 and 2026 to say anything about them.


CFD starting offers by placement year: median, middle half and 90th percentile, with n under each year. Amber columns rest on fewer than 20 placements. Snapshot: 15 Nov 2026. Source: Skill-Lync placement records.


Please read the 2024 column with care. Seventeen offers can move a lot because of two or three good placements. 2021 is also unusual: its middle half runs from ₹


2.42 to ₹


5.45 lakh and its top 10% from ₹


8 lakh, much wider than 2022 or 2023. The steady part of the story is 2022-23, when 157 placements give a median of ₹


3.5-3.6 lakh.


Out of all 240 CFD records, 201 (84%) are from 2021-23. That is why we show the year split at all: a single all-years median hides how old most of the data is.


## Which companies hire CFD engineers in India?


In Skill-Lync's records the most frequent CFD employers were Mechartes and Cyient (9 placements each), Analyzer CAE and Expleo Engineering (8 each), and Alten and Cummins (7 each). On AmbitionBox, the CFD employers with the most salary reports include Vertiv, Renault Nissan Technology & Business Centre India (RNTBCI), TCS, Applus IDIADA, L&T Technology Services, Valeo and Cummins.


Employers with three or more CFD placements in Skill-Lync's records (total CFD n = 240). Snapshot: 15 Nov 2026. Skill-Lync itself (5) and one entry with a job title typed in the company field (3) are left out.


Our list is mostly engineering-services and simulation firms, which do simulation work for client companies. Cummins and RNTBCI are the product-company and OEM R&D names in the list. None of these employers has 10 or more CFD placements in our records, so we don't show a median salary for any single company.


For a wider view, here are CFD roles open on Naukri on 16 Nov 2026 (postings close, so treat these as examples, not a live list):


- **Maruti Suzuki** : CAE Engineer / Analyst - CFD, automotive aerodynamics, 1-5 years, Pune and Gurugram.
- **FORVIA HELLA** : CFD Engineer, 1-3 years, Chennai, STAR-CCM+ preferred.
- **Valeo** : Thermal Simulation / CFD Engineer, 4-8 years, Chennai.
- **Tata Technologies** : CFD Engineer, 2-7 years, Pune, STAR-CCM+ for exhaust aftertreatment and spray modelling.
- **BMW TechWorks India** : CFD Simulation Engineer, 3-7 years, Pune, Ansys CFX and heat transfer.
- **Agile Technology** : CFD Engineer for turbomachinery aerodynamics, 2-6 years, Bengaluru.


## What moves a CFD engineer's salary?


The biggest levers on CFD pay in India are the employer, the industry, the city and years of real solver work. On AmbitionBox, the same "CFD Engineer" title averages ₹


9.5-10.5 lakh at Vertiv but ₹


6-6.8 lakh at L&T Technology Services. Pune averages ₹


7-7.8 lakh against ₹


4.9-5.7 lakh in Noida. No public data puts a price on knowing one solver over another.


### Employer type


Among the CFD employers on AmbitionBox with 10 or more salaries, average ranges run from ₹


5.2-7.1 lakh at TCS and ₹


6-6.8 lakh at L&T Technology Services up to ₹


7.7-10.8 lakh at Cummins and ₹


9.5-10.5 lakh at Vertiv. Compare the midpoints and Vertiv pays about 1.56 times LTTS for the same title. On these figures, product companies pay more than service firms for the same title. Service firms, though, made most of the CFD hires in our own records.


### Industry and application domain


For "CFD Engineer", AmbitionBox's highest-paying industry is industrial machinery ( ₹


7.5-8.7 lakh, 143 salaries), then auto components ( ₹


7.2-8, 145), engineering and construction ( ₹


6.7-8.2, 80), automobile ( ₹


6.6-7.7, 151) and IT services and consulting ( ₹


6.8-7.5, 269). The main CFD application areas map onto these industries:


- **Automotive thermal and aerodynamics** : underhood cooling, HVAC ducts, battery cooling, drag. OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers such as Valeo and FORVIA HELLA, and engineering-services firms.
- **Engines and aftertreatment** : combustion, sprays, exhaust treatment. Cummins appears in both our records and AmbitionBox, and Tata Technologies was hiring for aftertreatment CFD on 16 Nov 2026.
- **HVAC and buildings** : room airflow, data-centre cooling, smoke and fire studies. "HVAC" is among the top skills AmbitionBox lists for Senior CFD Engineers.
- **Turbomachinery and aerospace** : pumps, fans, compressors, turbines and external aerodynamics. Agile Technology's turbomachinery posting on 16 Nov 2026 asked for 2-6 years' experience.


### City


Pune has the most CFD salary reports on AmbitionBox and the highest city average ( ₹


7-7.8 lakh, 367 salaries). Bengaluru and Chennai both average ₹


6.5-7.2 lakh. Hyderabad averages ₹


5.2-7 lakh, and Noida ₹


4.9-5.7 lakh. At senior level, Bengaluru is the top-paying metro ( ₹


11.1-13 lakh for Senior CFD Engineer, 114 salaries).


### Tools: Ansys Fluent, STAR-CCM+, OpenFOAM, CONVERGE


No public data shows that one solver pays more than another, so be wary of anyone who says so. What the data does show is which tools employers ask for. AmbitionBox lists Ansys Fluent and STAR-CCM+ among the top skills for CFD engineers, along with HyperMesh and ANSA for meshing. In the Naukri postings above, STAR-CCM+ is named by FORVIA HELLA and Tata Technologies, and Ansys CFX by BMW TechWorks.


- **Ansys Fluent** is a general-purpose commercial solver and the first tool AmbitionBox lists among CFD engineers' top skills. Learn it first.
- **STAR-CCM+** shows up in automotive postings, such as the FORVIA HELLA and Tata Technologies roles above. The concepts carry over, so a second commercial solver is quicker to learn than the first.
- **OpenFOAM** is free, open-source CFD software, released every six months by OpenCFD Ltd (version v2606 came out in June 2026). Because you can see and change the code, it is a good way to show that you understand the numerics, not just the buttons. It appears in some smaller firms' postings, such as e-MUG Engineering Services in Hyderabad (2-6 years, ₹


4-7 lakh a year).
- **CONVERGE** (Convergent Science) generates its mesh automatically and is aimed at internal combustion engines, sprays, gas turbines and exhaust aftertreatment. It matters if you want engine or combustion work.


Interviews test the physics first. The CFD interview questions reported on AmbitionBox ask about the governing equations, turbulence models (RANS, LES, DNS) and steady versus transient solvers. Knowing a tool gets you shortlisted. Explaining why your result is right gets you the offer. Skill-Lync's[CFD courses hub](https://skill-lync.com/courses/cfd) lists the courses, fees and jobs data by tool, including[OpenFOAM](https://skill-lync.com/courses/openfoam) and[CONVERGE](https://skill-lync.com/courses/converge) .


## Does CFD pay more than FEA or CAE?


Slightly, at the start. In Skill-Lync's records the median CFD starting offer was ₹


3.5 lakh (n = 240), against ₹


3.2 lakh for CAE/FEA (n = 456), about 9% more. For freshers alone the gap is wider: ₹


3.5 lakh in CFD (n = 150) against ₹


3.0 lakh in CAE (n = 285). CAE had almost twice as many placements.

So should you pick CFD for the money? Not on these numbers alone. The gap is a few thousand rupees a month at the start, and CAE has about twice as many placements in our records, so more entry jobs. Choose the physics you enjoy: flow and heat (CFD), or strength, crash and vibration (FEA). For the CAE side, see our[CAE and FEA engineer salary guide](https://skill-lync.com/blogs/salary-packages-for-fea-engineers-in-india) . Our[CAE engineer salary page](https://skill-lync.com/salaries/cae-engineer) shows CAE and CFD fresher offers by employer and city from the same placement data.


## What is the career path for a CFD engineer in India?


Most CFD engineers in India start as a trainee or CFD engineer at a simulation-services firm or supplier. They move up to senior CFD engineer after three to six years, then to specialist, technical lead or manager. Pay roughly triples from a first offer to senior level: from a ₹


3.5 lakh median start to ₹


9-12 lakh.

Two skills tend to mark the move to senior roles. The first is validation: showing that the simulation agrees with test data, and explaining why when it doesn't. The second is scripting, to automate repeated set-ups and reports. AmbitionBox lists Python and automation among the top skills for Senior CFD Engineers.


## What salary increase can a CFD engineer expect in 2027?


Aon's salary survey, published 14 October 2026, projects average increments in 2027 of 9.5% in automotive and in engineering design services, 9.3% in engineering and manufacturing, and 6.6% in technology consulting and services. Across India it projects 9.1%. CFD engineers in automotive and design-services firms sit in the higher groups.


Worked example: take a CFD engineer earning ₹


6.1 lakh, the midpoint of AmbitionBox's 1-3 year range. At the automotive and design-services rate (9.5%), and at the technology-services rate (6.6%), next year's pay in lakh would be:

18,000 a year. A job change is a bigger lever than the annual increment: the step from AmbitionBox's 1-3 year midpoint ( ₹

8.0 lakh) is about 31%. These survey figures are averages across companies, not a promise for any one employer.


## How reliable are these CFD salary numbers?


Each source has limits, and it is better that you know them:


- **Skill-Lync placement records** only include learners who reported a placement. Most are first offers from 2021-23, and our CFD data has only 19 records from 2024-25 and none from 2026. They tell you what entry offers looked like, not current pay across the industry. We dropped groups under 10 people, so no single company's salary is shown.
- **AmbitionBox** shows a range for the average salary in each experience band, not the full spread. Its exact averages and top-10% figures need a login, and we did not use them. Bands with fewer than about 50 salaries (CFD Engineer 6-9 years, CFD Specialist) can swing.
- **Glassdoor** 's ₹


6.85 lakh average mixes all experience levels and includes bonus pay. It rests on 155 salaries.
- **Indeed** asked for a human-verification check when we tried its CFD salary page, so we did not use it. We used **Naukri** only for named job postings, because its search for "cfd engineer" also returns many unrelated jobs, which makes its counts meaningless.


Use the ranges to judge whether an offer is reasonable, not to predict a single number. If you are choosing a CFD course, Skill-Lync's[Post Graduate Program in CFD](https://skill-lync.com/mechanical-engineering-courses/masters-cfd) covers Ansys Fluent, OpenFOAM and CONVERGE with industry projects. A counsellor can tell you whether it fits your background.


## Frequently asked questions


### What is the salary of a CFD engineer fresher in India?


About ₹


2.8-4.5 lakh a year. In 150 Skill-Lync CFD fresher placements the median offer was ₹


3.5 lakh, and the top 10% got more than ₹


5.39 lakh (snapshot 15 Nov 2026). Offers titled GET or trainee were lower, with a median of ₹


3.25 lakh (n = 46).


### What is the salary of a CFD analyst in India?


On AmbitionBox, read 16 Nov 2026, a CFD analyst averages ₹


5.6-7.2 lakh with 1-3 years' experience, ₹


7.7-9 lakh with 3-6 years and ₹


9.2-12 lakh with 6-9 years, from 294 salaries. CFD analysts in the automobile industry average ₹


9.5-12.9 lakh.


### Can a CFD engineer earn ₹


10 lakh a year in India?


Yes, usually after about six years. AmbitionBox puts the "CFD Engineer" average at ₹


9.3-11.9 lakh for 6-9 years and "Senior CFD Engineer" at ₹


11.1-12.3 lakh. Some employers pay it earlier: Vertiv's average range for the CFD Engineer title is ₹


9.5-10.5 lakh.


### Is CFD a good career in India in terms of salary?


The start is modest, a ₹


3.5 lakh median in our records, but growth is steady. AmbitionBox's average nearly doubles between 1-3 years ( ₹


5.8-6.4 lakh) and the Senior CFD Engineer title ( ₹


11.1-12.3 lakh). Openings are fewer than in FEA/CAE, so a strong project portfolio and solid basics in fluid mechanics and heat transfer matter more than in most fresher roles.


### Which software should I learn to get a CFD job?


Start with Ansys Fluent, the first tool AmbitionBox lists among CFD engineers' top skills. Add STAR-CCM+ for automotive roles, CONVERGE for engine and combustion roles, and OpenFOAM to show you understand the numerics. No public data shows that one solver pays more. Interviews test the physics behind the tool.


### Do CFD engineers earn more than FEA engineers?


Slightly, at the start. In Skill-Lync's records the CFD median starting offer was ₹


3.5 lakh (n = 240), against ₹


3.2 lakh for CAE/FEA (n = 456), snapshot 15 Nov 2026. CAE/FEA had almost twice as many placements, so it has more entry-level openings.
